label.fr: Banque africaine de développement (BAD)

description.fr: Bibliothèque d'exigences POSSIBLES pour un projet financé par la Banque africaine de développement, établie d'après le manuel des décaissements (2020), le manuel de gestion financière (2014), les lignes directrices de gestion financière (2019), les lignes directrices de rapports et d'audit et le format du rapport d'achèvement. Ce n'est pas un modèle universel : l'accord de financement et la lettre de décaissement du projet décident de ce qui s'applique, avec quelle périodicité et selon quel modèle ; ces documents d'orientation ne donnent ni montants, ni taux de financement, ni catégories. Seule la périodicité recommandée du rapport financier intermédiaire (trimestrielle, 45 jours) est livrée ; chaque citation renvoie à la page du document, vérifiable par l'empreinte SHA-256. Chaque élément se lit « lorsque requis ».
description.en: Library of POSSIBLE requirements for a project financed by the African Development Bank, drawn from the disbursement handbook (2020), the financial management manual (2014), the financial management guidelines (2019), the reporting and audit guidelines and the completion report format. This is not a universal template: the project's financing agreement and disbursement letter decide what applies, with what periodicity and according to which template; these guidance documents give no amounts, financing percentages or categories. Only the recommended periodicity of the interim financial report (quarterly, 45 days) is shipped; each citation points to the document page, checkable by SHA-256 fingerprint. Each element reads “when required”.

label.fr: Rapport financier intermédiaire (IFR) — recommandation trimestrielle

note.fr: Le manuel de 2014 recommande 45 jours après la fin de chaque trimestre civil, avec le rapport d'avancement ; ses lignes directrices antérieures disaient « trois mois ». Le format, le contenu et la périodicité se conviennent à l'évaluation du projet : l'accord du projet prime. Contenu attendu : sources et emplois, écart prévu/réalisé, lien entre avancement financier et physique.
note.en: The 2014 manual recommends 45 days after the end of each calendar quarter, with the progress report; the earlier guidelines said “three months”. Format, content and periodicity are agreed at project appraisal: the project's agreement prevails. Expected content: sources and uses, planned vs actual variance, link between financial and physical progress.

delai_type.fr: 45 jours après la fin de chaque trimestre civil (recommandation du manuel de 2014)
delai_type.en: 45 days after the end of each calendar quarter (2014 manual recommendation)

label.fr: Dates d'éligibilité des dépenses

citations.quote: In general, expenses incurred before the signature of the Legal Agreement are not eligible for financing.
Only expenses incurred from the signature date and, at the latest, the closing date of the related financing agreement, would be considered eligible.

However, on a prior agreement between the Bank and the Borrower, a special clause in the Legal Agreement authorising the financing of certain expenses incurred before the date of signature of the Legal Agreement may be included to facilitate project implementation.
expenditures incurred after the closing date, except for audit-related expenses incurred up to 6 months after the closing date

note.fr: Exception : à appliquer à la catégorie des frais d'audit, avec la fin propre à la catégorie.
note.en: Exception: apply to the audit-fees category, with the category's own end.

label.fr: Décaissements dans la limite des allocations par catégorie

citations.quote: Disbursements are made within the limit of the amounts allocated to each category.
Disbursements may not be made directly from the “unallocated” category of the loan agreement.
the Borrower must obtain the Bank’s prior approval of the revised allocation before incurring further expenditure or submitting a disbursement request under that category.

label.fr: Une seule devise par demande de décaissement

citations.quote: Each disbursement request should be for amounts payable in one currency.
If the contract is expressed in several currencies, a separate disbursement request is required for each currency of payment.

raison.fr: Aucun champ de la demande ne porte une devise de paiement distincte de celle de l'accord : la règle n'a rien à contrôler tant que le modèle n'en distingue pas.
raison.en: No request field carries a payment currency distinct from the agreement's: the rule has nothing to check until the model distinguishes one.

label.fr: Numérotation chronologique des demandes

citations.quote: Request Number: Disbursement requests should be numbered chronologically with a maximum of 4 digits (e.g. 0001, 0002, etc.), regardless of the disbursement method used.
the submissions should be numbered chronologically, with a maximum of 4 digits followed by JUS.
the project coordinator should assign a 3-character alpha identification for each agency
The identification number accorded to a cancelled disbursement request should be considered cancelled and not attributed to a replacement or subsequent submission.
When a project includes a loan and a grant, each should follow separate chronological numbering of disbursement requests.

raison.fr: Le numéro d'une demande est libre (unique par organisation) : le format à 4 chiffres, le suffixe d'agence et le suffixe JUS ne sont pas contrôlés.
raison.en: A request number is free-form (unique per organisation): the 4-digit format, agency suffix and JUS suffix are not checked.

label.fr: Délai de soumission après la clôture

citations.quote: The Borrower is granted an additional four months after the closing date to submit disbursement requests and supporting documentation for expenditures incurred on or before the closing date.
the Borrower should submit a formal request for extension to the Bank at least six (6) months before the closing date.

label.fr: Pièces du remboursement

citations.quote: Evidence of payment showing the amount paid, the date of payment and the payee
A bank attestation stating the exchange rate applied for the operation

label.fr: Coordonnées du fournisseur au premier paiement direct
label.en: Supplier account details at first direct payment

citations.quote: The Borrower must submit full account details of the supplier/contractor with its first request for direct payment.

raison.fr: Les coordonnées du fournisseur ne sont pas rattachées à la première demande de paiement direct.
raison.en: Supplier account details are not linked to the first direct payment request.

label.fr: Même méthode pour toutes les demandes d'un contrat
label.en: Same method for all claims under a contract

citations.quote: Withdrawals against a contract, using one method of disbursement, must continue to use the same method for all subsequent claims under that contract, unless otherwise approved by the Bank.

raison.fr: Une demande n'est pas rattachée à un contrat : la méthode ne peut pas être imposée contrat par contrat (le profil n'autorise que des méthodes par accord).
raison.en: A request is not linked to a contract: the method cannot be enforced per contract (the profile only enables methods per agreement).

label.fr: Conditions de reconstitution du compte spécial

citations.quote: The Special Account will be replenished on the condition that the Bank has received Statements of Expenditure in respect of at least 50% of the immediately preceding advance and 100% of older advances.

The last replenishment shall generally take place no later than 6 months before the closing date, provided that the immediately preceding advance has been justified up to at least 50 percent and that the other older advances have been fully justified.
Justification should be submitted as often as possible, but at least semi-annually, unless otherwise agreed.
The Borrower must, within 4 months of the closing date, refund to the Bank, in the currency of the Special Account, any unused/unjustified balance.

raison.fr: Les seuils de 50 % / 100 % de justification, les 6 mois avant clôture et le remboursement du solde n'ont pas de champ dans le profil de décaissement.
raison.en: The 50% / 100% justification thresholds, the 6 months before closing and the balance refund have no field in the disbursement profile.

label.fr: Usage du compte spécial

citations.quote: The account shall be used only for the loan, and shall not receive any counterpart funds or other resources.
The Special Account may neither be used as collateral nor incur overdrafts

raison.fr: L'interdiction de fonds de contrepartie, de découvert et de garantie sur le compte spécial n'est pas contrôlée.
raison.en: The ban on counterpart funds, overdrafts and collateral on the special account is not checked.

label.fr: Audit annuel et suspension des reconstitutions
label.en: Annual audit and suspension of replenishments

citations.quote: The audit report must be completed and submitted to the Bank within six (6) months of the end of the fiscal year.

the Bank will discontinue the use of statements of expenditure as supporting documentation for disbursements and withhold additional advances to the Special Account until the Borrower provides acceptable audited financial statements.

raison.fr: Le délai de six mois après l'exercice s'exprime en mois : il n'est pas converti en échéance (voir l'exigence « états audités », sans décalage en jours) et la suspension des reconstitutions n'est pas appliquée.
raison.en: The six-month deadline after the year-end is in months: it is not converted into a due date (see the “audited statements” requirement, no day offset) and the suspension of replenishments is not applied.

label.fr: Signataires autorisés avant le premier décaissement

citations.quote: Before disbursements may commence, the Borrower is required to designate officials authorised to sign disbursement requests and provide to the Bank originals of their specimen signatures.

raison.fr: Les signataires autorisés et leurs spécimens ne sont pas enregistrés.
raison.en: Authorised signatories and their specimens are not recorded.
